directions: Suppose your class plans to invite some former graduates to share their job experiences with the students. As the organizer of the activity, you are now to write an invitation letter to the invited speakers on behalf of your class. You will have 30 minutes to write the letter. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Dear former graduates,

I'm writing on behalf of our class to invite you to share your job experiences with us. To begin with, our classmates are eager to learn about the real-world work environment. Your first-hand experiences can offer us insights into different industries and job roles. For example, you can tell us about the skills and qualities that are highly valued in the workplace.

In addition, your stories of success and failure can be extremely inspiring. They will teach us how to face challenges and setbacks in our future careers. Moreover, we believe your advice can help us make more informed decisions about our career paths.

We plan to hold this sharing session in the school auditorium at 3 p.m. next Saturday. We would be extremely grateful if you could spare some time to join us.

In conclusion, we sincerely hope you can accept our invitation and look forward to your positive reply.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
